create.name: Shannon Shine
create.bio:
Shannon Shine is an American intuitive, painter and Reiki practitioner whose work moves between art and spiritual guidance. She describes seeing auras from early childhood and, after a run of losses in her own life, turning more fully to the spirit world for direction. She trained in Usui Reiki and now works as an intuitive energy worker, passing on messages and helping clients read the signs and coincidences in their lives. With her partner Selomon she co-founded Shine Time Studios and a sound-bath project, Shine Resonance, and she co-hosts the Bring Me 2 Life podcast.

Her one-to-one Soul Sessions, held online, follow whatever the client brings: intuitive readings, past-life and Akashic journeys, a hypnosis-based method she calls quantum healing, inner-child work and creative coaching. Clients can book single sessions or packages, join a lower-cost monthly membership with a short session and a monthly group ceremony, or take a longer three-month mentorship. She also runs online group courses such as Release and Rise, offers meditation, sound and cacao gatherings for festivals and retreats, and leads art workshops in which painting becomes a reflective practice. She sells her own paintings and jewellery and streams live on Insight Timer.

courses.title: 3 Soul Session Package
courses.description: Three private online Soul Sessions of 30 minutes, an hour or two hours each. A session can take the form of an intuitive reading, a past-life or Akashic journey, energy clearing or creative coaching, depending on what the client needs that day.

courses.title: Monthly Magic Membership
courses.description: A flexible monthly plan with one half-hour session or card reading, an invitation to her monthly group ceremony and community check-in, a monthly Muse Letter and short audio inspirations each week.

courses.title: Divine Journey Mentorship
courses.description: A three-month one-to-one programme with two short check-ins and a monthly past-life or quantum session, morning and evening meditations made for the client, and access to her course portal and community.

courses.title: Release & Rise
courses.description: A six-week online group course on building confidence and trusting your own timing, with a private group chat and a live monthly call with Shannon.

free_resources.title: Shannon Shine on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Shannon's free Insight Timer page, where her guided meditations and recorded live sessions can be played in the app or a web browser at no cost.
